text: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of two (2) years thereafter, the Consultant shall not, directly or indirectly, engage in any competing business or provide services to any competitor of the Company within India.

The Employee agrees that for eighteen months after termination, they shall not solicit or accept employment from any client of the Company, and this non-compete restriction shall apply across all States in India.
The Distributor shall not engage in any competing business anywhere in the territory for a period of five years after this Agreement ends.
Franchisee shall not, during the term and for three years after, provide services in the Territory that compete with the Franchisor's business.
In the event of late delivery, the Supplier shall pay a penalty of Rs. 50,000 per week of delay, irrespective of the actual loss suffered by the Buyer.
Any breach of confidentiality obligations shall attract a penalty of INR 10,00,000 payable immediately, regardless of the extent of damage caused.
Failure to complete the milestone on time shall result in forfeiture of the entire advance payment as penalty, without regard to actual loss.
If the Vendor delays delivery, liquidated damages of 1% of contract value per week of delay shall apply, subject to a cap of 10%, representing a genuine pre-estimate of loss.
The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time, without cause or notice, at its sole discretion, and the Employee shall have no right to object or claim compensation.
The Licensor may terminate this Agreement without cause upon written notice, in its sole discretion, at any time during the term.
The Landlord may terminate this lease at any time without cause by giving the Tenant seven days' notice, at the Landlord's sole discretion.
The Employer may terminate this Agreement without notice or reason whenever it deems fit in its absolute discretion, with immediate effect.
The Contractor shall be fully liable for any and all losses, damages, claims and expenses arising in connection with this Agreement, with no limitation on liability whatsoever.
There shall be no limitation on liability of the Service Provider under this Agreement, and the Service Provider shall be liable for any and all direct and indirect losses.
The Vendor's liability under this Agreement is unlimited liability and shall extend to all claims made by the Client at any time.
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary, the Consultant shall be liable for any and all damages suffered by the Client without any cap or limit on liability.

Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be referred to arbitration, and the arbitrator shall be sole appointed by the Company, with the seat of arbitration being decided solely at the Company's discretion.
Only the Company may refer any dispute to arbitration; the Employee shall have no right to invoke arbitration and must pursue any claim solely through internal grievance procedures.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before expiry.
The subscription shall auto-renew every twelve months at the then-current rate unless the Customer cancels through the online portal before the renewal date.
Upon expiry of the initial term, this Agreement shall be deemed renewed for successive periods of one year unless terminated by either party with 30 days' notice.

All intellectual property created by the Contractor, whether related to this engagement or otherwise, including prior and pre-existing works, shall be assigned to the Company irrevocably and worldwide.
The Freelancer irrevocably assigns all right, title, and interest in all intellectual property, including unrelated personal projects, to the Client in perpetuity and worldwide.

All work product shall be considered work made for hire and all work, material and output produced by the Developer, whether within or outside the scope of this engagement, shall vest solely in the Company.
All payments made under this Agreement are non-refundable under any circumstances, including early termination by the Company.
The Customer is not entitled to any refund of fees already paid, regardless of the reason for cancellation.
No refunds shall be provided for any unused portion of the subscription period once payment has been made.

The Company may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause at its sole discretion. All fees paid are non-refundable under any circumstances. Any delay by the Customer in performing obligations shall attract a penalty of Rs. 25,000 per day.

Employee shall not engage in any competing business for two years post-termination anywhere in India. The Employer's liability for any and all claims arising under this Agreement is unlimited liability without any cap.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive terms unless cancelled. The Company may terminate this Agreement without cause or notice at its sole discretion at any time.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, and the courts at Bengaluru shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

Each party shall maintain the confidentiality of the other party's proprietary information disclosed under this Agreement and shall not disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent.
The Company shall pay the Consultant a monthly fee of Rs. 75,000, payable within 15 days of receipt of a valid invoice.
Either party may terminate this Agreement upon 30 days' written notice to the other party, and both parties shall cooperate in good faith to ensure an orderly transition.
The Warranty Period for the goods supplied under this Agreement shall be twelve months from the date of delivery, during which the Seller shall repair or replace defective goods at no cost.
Each party shall maintain comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least Rs. 50,00,000 throughout the term of this Agreement.
Any notice required under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by registered post or email to the addresses set out in Schedule A.
The Parties agree to attempt to resolve any dispute amicably through good-faith negotiation before either party initiates arbitration proceedings before a mutually appointed sole arbitrator.
This Agreement, together with its Schedules and Annexures, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior discussions.
The Client shall reimburse the Consultant for reasonable, pre-approved travel expenses incurred in the course of performing services under this Agreement.
